column1: # Slice 307 (CALL-WHOLE-ARGUMENTS-STRUCTURE), try a11: a10 with the kernel binder lmx_call_bind_whole reading the fields of the value as its named
# cells -- the native layout of a declared Structure keeps a step cell beside each place (the procedure width is kids + steps: Args (c, a) has
# four cells, c at 0 and a at 2; gdb307-b/c on the p307f program: slotname1 = 0, the cell 1 value a STRUCT), and the first form refused the
# unnamed cell as a field without a formal (the implicit `call`: p307e, p307f exit 102); the nullary special case is gone with it. Other
# sources unchanged since a10 (tool170b and fe170f stay; the runtime is rebuilt as rt170d). Run by `lmxtool steps` with the working tool of boot164a.
